Banner.Description: With over 5 years of experience, I enjoy creating apps and exploring how computers work. Whether it's building something new, solving problems, or just having fun with tech, I'm always excited to dive in and make things happen!
AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: Hi there! I'm Michael, a fourth-year computer science student at the University of Waterloo!
I enjoy tinkering with computers, whether it's diving into the architecture of old consoles or playing around with my server and debugging another DNS bug ( – ⤙ – )
In my free time, I love playing video games like Smash Ultimate and Balatro. I'm also passionate about learning Japanese and hopefully taking the time to finally read a book.
Some of the technologies/languages I've worked with include (but are not limited to):
Experience.Title: Experience

Experience.Jobs.Title: Backend Developer
Description: Architected automated workflows using Temporal, Express.js, and PostgreSQL to optimize the onboarding upgrade flow, resulting in a 23% increase in operational efficiency.
Optimized CI/CD pipelines and testing suites using Vitest, ArgoCD, and Kubernetes; leveraged Grafana for monitoring to achieve a 72% reduction in test execution time.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Backend Developer
Description: Implemented PCI compliant data masking across three Spring Boot orchestration services, reducing sensitive-field exposure and aligning cross-team services under a unified security standard.
Designed and delivered a consolidated REST API endpoint supporting both payment and tax workflows, cutting redundant service calls and simplifying integration for partner teams.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Full Stack Developer
Description: Developed an internal AI Assistant using Langchain, RAG, PgVector, and semantic chunking techniques to streamline documentation access, improving response relevance and reducing latency.
Built a Spring Boot sidecar service containerized with Docker and deployed on OpenShift 4 to isolate fraud detection services, reducing duplicate code and simplifying integration for developers.
Migrated CI/CD workflows from Jenkins to GitHub Actions, automating test, build, and deployment pipelines to reduce manual steps and overall pipeline duration.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Full Stack Developer
Description: Developed and maintained projects and REST APIs utilizing Angular, Spring Boot, and Postman for the Digital Development Security Team.
Engineered a detailed web application with Angular and Spring Boot to decode JSON web tokens and provide additional information about RBC security tokens.
Architected and implemented a token onboarding portal across multiple development environments using Redis, Docker, and Openshift.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Junior Analyst/Associate
Description: Designed and implemented projects using C# with ASP.NET MVC 5 and MS SQL for the Law Group Technology Team
Demonstrated proficiency in data analysis and visualization through the use of Tableau to extract meaningful insights from various sources
Engineered and implemented automated solutions, including the development of Excel Macros using Visual Basic, resulting in substantial time savings and heightened efficiency
